Terms of use

Effective October 13, 2026. Heads is operated by Aman Mehmood. The pilot is for adults aged 18 and over.

Heads coordinates recreational pickup basketball. Court coverage, access, headcounts, attendance and availability are not guaranteed. A check-in means a recent proximity check, not a guarantee that someone stayed or played. Follow posted venue rules and verify conditions before travelling.

Keep your account secure. Do not submit false activity, harass others, impersonate someone, misuse account codes, or include unnecessary sensitive information in reports. Blocking affects account privacy and alerts; it cannot enforce physical separation at public courts.

Use the safety reporting flow for incidents. Heads is not an emergency service and does not promise continuous monitoring. For an immediate emergency contact local emergency services. The operator may suspend accounts or cancel runs to address misuse. Contact support about review or appeals.

You are responsible for deciding whether a venue and activity are suitable for you. Play involves physical risks; participation is voluntary. Nothing here limits rights that cannot be limited by applicable law. The pilot may change or become unavailable. Material changes to these terms will be communicated in the app or on this page before continued use is requested.

See the privacy policy and account deletion portal. Questions: support@headsapp.co.
